findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 4 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 52 questions numbered 1-52; by section: 4.1 27, 4.2 25.

Covers both sections in book order; every 'difference' question is answered as a two-column table. None repeats the chapter exercise (GUI and its importance, why Tkinter, creating windows and frames, naming two widgets, purpose of layout management, pack(), event-driven programming, handling input, CRUD and connecting to SQLite are left to the exercise; questions here take other angles). Every sqlite3 program was run in Python 3 and its real output is given; Tkinter behaviour was checked by running the programs. Read uses the SQL command SELECT (Table 4.1 prints 'READ' in its Command column).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
